evidence.citation: “Repeat the same case blindly 2–3 more times, using a fresh, context-free agent for every run” and “Isolate each run and sweep the live checkout afterward for leaked changes.”
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The repeated blind runs address nondeterminism, while isolation, leak sweeps, independent judging, pass-rate reporting, and regression reruns protect validity, integrity, and reproducibility. Under the supplied bar, this is necessary execution work rather than a cost regression.
